## Parent

turnkey-vnm

## What to build

With bazel-remote started by hand and the runner's `on` mode passed after `--`, the runner writes an ActionResult after each passing local run, under the action digest buck2 reported. A second run of an unchanged rust_test is then a hit: the test does not execute (spec §3).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Second run of an unchanged rust_test does not execute the test and reports a pass with the original output and duration
- [ ] The hit survives a daemon restart, `buck2 clean` and a second checkout of the same revision
- [ ] Failed, timed-out and fatal runs are never recorded, and always run again
- [ ] Recorded entries carry execution_metadata, buck2's instance_name and project-relative output paths
- [ ] Without the `on` flag, nothing is read or recorded
